what: The video or photo covering the panel is redrawn with PixiJS, and the moment loading clears, a noise wave passes for 2.8s — distortion strength rises and falls on a sin curve and settles down over the last 25%, and the edges (4%) don’t wobble (PC strength .01 · size 2.5, phone .008 · 1). When it finishes, the filter is removed and only the video is drawn.
ease: sin(πt)·(0.35+0.65·(1−c²)) — c is progress over the last 25%

options.wait: Name of the document event that starts the wave — give the event fired when the loader lifts (brand home-loading:closing). If omitted, it draws as soon as it is drawn. If the event arrives again, it waves again
options.[data-fx-part=media]: Video, photo or canvas to draw (child) — the part covers the panel size (cover) and hides the original element

from.where: index.html .h-mv (Hero — original: PixiJS 8.19.0 video sprite with fbm noise gradient filter, 2.8s after home-loading:closing, 30fps, canvas 10px taller than the screen)

note: The filter formula was measured from the original and written anew. If the panel height exceeds the screen, the canvas is drawn 10px longer so no gap shows when the address bar collapses (same as the original)
